en.headline: Software update triggers four-hour parking meter outage across Hong Kong
en.dek: Transport Department says about 11,000 meters failed after an early software update on Tuesday; system restored by 12.15pm with full refunds arranged.
body: A software update caused a citywide outage of Hong Kong’s parking meter system for nearly four hours on Tuesday, the Transport Department said.

The department received a report from the operator at about 8.20am that the system had malfunctioned, with payment functions suspended or displays not working normally. Preliminary investigations found that an update in the early hours led to a back-end software fault that prevented normal connection with the meters, affecting about 11,000 units across the city.

The system resumed normal operations at 12.15pm. The operator will arrange full refunds for all meter transactions between 8am and 12.15pm to the same payment method, aiming to complete approvals this week. There is no evidence the system was attacked, and the matter has been reported to the Digital Policy Office.
The department has instructed the operator to conduct a thorough investigation and submit a detailed report to prevent recurrence. Motorists can call the service hotline at 2332 3700 for enquiries.

zh.headline: 凌晨軟件更新致全港咪錶系統故障約四小時
zh.dek: 運輸署指約一萬一千個咪錶受影響，系統於下午十二時十五分恢復，營運商將安排全數退款。
body: 運輸署表示，星期二凌晨的軟件更新導致全港咪錶泊車系統出現故障，持續近四小時。
署方於早上約八時二十分接獲營運商報告系統故障，支付功能暫停或咪錶顯示未能正常運作。初步調查發現，凌晨更新後台軟件出現故障，未能與咪錶正常連接，涉及全港約一萬一千個咪錶。
系統已於下午十二時十五分恢復正常運作。營運商將就上午八時至下午十二時十五分的所有咪錶交易安排全數退款至同一支付工具，並爭取本星期內完成審批。至今沒有證據顯示系統被攻擊，署方已通報數字政策辦公室。
署方已責成營運商徹底調查事故原因及提交詳盡報告，防止同類事件再發生。駕駛人士如有查詢可致電服務熱線2332 3700。
